origin.source: Published benchmark protocols and evaluation code cited in the setting records.

scope: Descriptive audit of inspected benchmark designs and reporting, extended by the separate numerical and artifact analyses in experiments/2026-10-05. Null means not assessed for this setting, not absence of capability.

eligible_populations.clarification: Eight specified conversational settings. BIRD-History is retrieval context, not user clarification.
eligible_populations.coverage_risk: Four selected settings: CLARITY multi-turn, TrustSQL, SCARE, ABISS predicted-category. Does not assert exhaustive eligibility.
eligible_populations.interpretation_recovery: AmbiQT and AMBROSIA, for simultaneous alternative recovery. TIDE-Bench intent drift is a changed request.

qualifications.Derivable: Paired coverage and selective risk recoverable for checked populations. Two inconsistent TrustSQL cells excluded: Advising T5-Error_M and ATIS CLS_P-MAC-SQL.
qualifications.By category: SCARE reconstruction separately within initially correct and initially incorrect answerable categories.
qualifications.SQL matching: Recovery metric uses SQL matching, without a separate meaning-level score. Natural-language meaning annotations may still exist.
qualifications.No check found: AmbiQT four generators at commit 2dd908bd4a7173f98fa6637758f4d41852722a5c. Does not establish equal outputs.
qualifications.Not recoverable: Inspected published tables do not provide aligned statistics. Not a claim about protocol capability.
qualifications.System-selected: Protocol permits system-generated/selected questions. Does not establish quality of clarification.
qualifications.Required: AMBROSIA construction requires distinct, nonempty full gold results. Execution found two duplicate-reference exceptions. Not a guarantee under every prediction matcher or output projection.

grouping: 11 source studies. The source Overleaf draft called these benchmark families, but the list includes Sphinteract system experiments.
verification_boundary: The 13-setting design audit remains distinct from numerical reconstructions and saved-output/gold-query checks. Those checks, exact versions and exclusions are recorded in experiments/2026-10-05. No new model inference.
